# Stat

One metric on a dashboard: muted label, large tabular value, small unit, optional trend and help text.

`KenosUI.Stat` · Homelab

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Stat label={…} value={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Stat" label="{{…}}" value="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

One metric: label, big tabular value, unit, optional trend.

## Props (StatProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `value` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `unit` | `React.ReactNode` | Small muted unit after the value, e.g. "ms", "GB", "°C". |
| `help` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `trend` | `{ value: string; direction?: "up" \| "down" }` | Change vs. previous period. up = green, down = red. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Value 20 / 24 / 30px. Default "md". |
| `sparkline` | `number[]` | Trend line under the value (ink). |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>._
